title: Why Is Node.js Used? knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which approach best supports reliable work with Why Is Node.js Used??
options: Separate language features from runtime APIs, and state which runtime/version a snippet requires.

questions.answer_key: Separate language features from runtime APIs, and state which runtime/version a snippet requires.
